CustomField.description: The address alerts are actually sent to: the linked user's email when a user is set, otherwise the typed address. A formula, not a stored copy, so a user who changes their Salesforce email is picked up immediately with nothing to re-save. The alert flow reads this field.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Derived. Set the Salesforce User or the Email field to change it.
CustomField.label: Effective Email
